checks.detail: One release launch. Apple Books fixture. Grid shows Plain Essay, Field Guide, and Folder Book. Extracted covers are apple_essay-1.png 80x120, apple_folder-1.png 80x120, and apple_guide-1.png 120x180 from PDF page 1. None is the old 1x1 file.
继续阅读 shows Plain Essay at 第 2 页 with no percent, because that EPUB has no page total. Field Guide shows 100% because its PDF total is 1.
PDF row count is 1 and the grid shows only Field Guide.
添加来源 then calibre adds a calibre row with count 1. 全部书籍 becomes 4 and Harbor Notes appears. Its cover is calibre_1.png 80x120 from the EPUB package.
Right arrow moved Plain Essay from page 1 to page 2. Opening Field Guide left that page at 2. Reopening Plain Essay still stored page 2, shown as 第 2 页.
The live 1300 by 763 pt window laid the card out at 6.0 pt on the left, top, right, and bottom. Sidebar 220, chat 320.
The release spike-shell was the only launch in this run.
Plain Essay opened from its cover in that same process.
Right arrow moved Plain Essay from page 1 to page 2.
